title: UPSC CDS II 2026 Answer Key Released
vacancyDetails: Total 451 vacancies across Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy, Air Force Academy and Officers Training Academy (OTA) for CDS II 2026.
qualification: Bachelor's degree for IMA, OTA and Air Force Academy (with Physics and Mathematics in 10+2 for Air Force). Engineering degree for Naval Academy candidates.
ageLimit: Minimum age: 20 years; maximum age: 24 years as on 01/07/2027. Age relaxation as per UPSC rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 200; SC / ST / female candidates: Nil. Fee payment through debit card, credit card, net banking or e-challan.
selectionProcess: Written examination → SSB interview / personality test → Medical examination → Final merit list
documentsRequired: Admit card, valid photo ID, application details, educational certificates, and supporting documents as required during further stages.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UPSC portal.
2. Complete OTR registration if required.
3. Fill the CDS II 2026 application form.
4. Upload the required documents and live photo.
5. Pay the fee and submit the form.
6. Save the confirmation page and print the application.
shortDescription: UPSC has released the provisional answer key for CDS II 2026. Candidates can check the official English, General Knowledge and Elementary Mathematics answer keys here.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the provisional answer key for the Combined Defence Services Examination (CDS) II 2026.

The written examination was held on 13 September 2026. The official provisional answer keys are available for English, General Knowledge and Elementary Mathematics.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 20 May 2026
  • Last date to apply online: 11 June 2026
  • Fee payment last date: 11 June 2026
  • Exam date: 13 September 2026
  • Admit card available: 03 September 2026
  • Answer key available: 16 September 2026

Vacancy details

Total vacancies: 451 posts

  • Indian Military Academy (IMA): 100
  • Indian Naval Academy: 26
  • Air Force Academy: 32
  • Officers Training Academy (OTA): 293

Answer key

The official provisional answer keys for English, General Knowledge and Elementary Mathematics are available on the UPSC website. Candidates can also raise objections as per the official notice.
